instructions:
FlowState is the user's project memory (todos, changes, decisions, problems, learnings).
1. At the start of every conversation about a project, call start_here(project="<name>") first and read the brief. If you don't know the project, call start_here() with no arguments (or with folder="<working folder>") to see the list, then pick one.
2. As you work, record what matters with log_work(project="<name>", kind=..., summary=...): kind=decision for choices made, change for things changed, problem for bugs/blockers, learning for lessons, todo for follow-ups. One short line each; add details only when useful.
3. Every write must name the project. Never put passwords, tokens or keys in any text. If you know your model name, pass it as model="<name>" on writes; never guess or invent it (leave it out).
4. A session is opened and closed for you automatically; you don't need to manage it. Its auto-captured summary, and anything you log with suggested=true, waits in a review queue for the user. Never approve or reject review items unless the user explicitly asks you to in this chat. The user's review mode (shown in the brief) decides what else waits; never change it unless the user asks you to in this chat.
5. Things shared between projects (a protocol, a library) are linked with the link tool; log changes to a shared component by its name and the other projects are alerted.
6. The brief starts with the project's HARD RULES: never break them. If it shows a HANDOFF note, continue from it and mark it picked up (handoff action=pickup). If you must stop mid-task, leave one: handoff(action="leave", project=..., where_i_was=..., next_step=...).
7. If FlowState is slow, errors, or is unavailable, tell the user once and carry on with their task without it. Never retry more than once.

prompts.description: Load FlowState project memory and work with it for this conversation.
prompts.name: flowstate-start

tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST in every conversation about a project. Returns a brief (max 4,000 characters) with the project's hard rules (never break them), any handoff note from the last AI, open todos, open problems, recent changes, recent decisions and key learnings, and opens a FlowState session automatically. Pass project="<name>" (or id). size=quick (short) or deep (longer, up to 12,000) if needed. Unknown project? Call with no arguments, or with folder="<working folder>", to get the list of projects.

folder.description: Working folder; its name is matched to a project if project is not given

project.description: Project name or id

size.description: quick (about 1,500 characters), standard (4,000) or deep (up to 12,000)

tools.name: start_here

tools.description: Record work as you go (write; project required). kind: decision (a choice made and why), change (something changed), problem (bug or blocker), learning (lesson or gotcha), todo (follow-up). summary: one short line. details: optional. component: optional component name (changes and problems default to 'General'). suggested=true: you are not sure the user wants this recorded, so it goes to the review queue instead of being saved. priority (todos; severity for problems): critical, urgent, normal (default), low. source: user_stated (the user said it), ai_inferred (your conclusion) or from_code (read in code or commits). Never include secrets (writes containing keys, tokens or passwords are refused).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

priority.description: Todos: priority. Problems: severity. critical, urgent, normal (default), low; older names high/medium also work.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

replaces.description: Decisions only: id of the earlier decision this one replaces

source.description: Where it comes from: user_stated, ai_inferred, from_code

suggested.description: true = put it in the review queue for the user instead of saving it

tools.name: log_work

tools.description: List items waiting in the review queue (auto-captured session summaries and records logged with suggested=true). Read-only. Show them to the user; approving or rejecting is the user's decision.

project.description: Project name or id (optional: all projects)

tools.name: review_list

tools.description: Approve a review item so it becomes a normal FlowState record. To edit then approve, pass the corrected summary/details (or priority/category/component). ONLY call this when the user has explicitly told you, in this chat, to approve or reject this specific item. Never decide on your own initiative, and never approve your own suggestions unless the user explicitly says so. user_request must quote the user's words. Write: requires project="<name>".

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

move_to.description: Clean-up 'misfiled' items: the project to move it to, if not the suggested one

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

user_request.description: The user's own words in this chat asking for this decision

tools.name: review_approve

tools.description: Reject a review item. It is kept, marked rejected, with the user's reason (nothing is deleted). ONLY call this when the user has explicitly told you, in this chat, to approve or reject this specific item. Never decide on your own initiative, and never approve your own suggestions unless the user explicitly says so. user_request must quote the user's words. Write: requires project="<name>".

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

tools.description: Link things across projects (write for add/remove; project required). Use when projects share something, e.g. several apps use one protocol: link(action="add", project="App A", link_type="uses", target_project="Owner", target_component="Wire Protocol"). Source is the project, or component="<name in project>", or item_type+item_id (decision, change, learning, problem, todo). Target: target_project (+ target_component), target_type+target_id, or url (a GitHub/Linear link to keep on a record). link_type: uses, depends_on, part_of, same_as (also supersedes, subtask_of, blocks). Changes logged on a shared component alert every project linked to it (an update todo + a note in its brief). FlowState only alerts; it does not change other apps' code. remove: link_id (or the add fields). list: links of the project or of one item.

component.description: Source: a component of project, by name

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

target_component.description: Target: a component of target_project, by name

url.description: Target: a GitHub / Linear / other https URL

tools.name: link

tools.description: Read or change the review mode: which new records wait in the review queue for the user's OK. Modes: off (nothing waits), auto_only (default: only auto-captured items), types (also the listed kinds), everything. action=get is read-only. action=set ONLY when the user has explicitly asked you, in this chat, to change the review mode; never change it on your own initiative or to get your writes saved. user_request must quote the user's words; every change is logged with them. project=... sets an override for one project (clear=true removes it); no project = the whole install.

kinds.description: mode=types: which kinds wait for review

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Optional: one project's override (default: whole install)

tools.name: review_mode

tools.description: Edit history of FlowState records, and undo. action=list (read): recent edits and deletes in a project, or of one record (record_type + record_id), with old and new values. action=undo (write; project required): put back the last change to that record (a deleted record comes back); recorded too, so undoing again redoes it. Refused if the record changed again since. New records are not undone here (set them done/cancelled). action=who (read): who did what, newest first, across projects or one project: app, model, machine and how the app was identified, for edits, review decisions, links, handoffs, rules and new records; filters by_app, by_model, by_machine, since, until (local time, e.g. 2026-10-17 or 2026-10-17 14:30), page.

by_app.description: who: only this app (part of the name)

by_model.description: who: only this model (part of the name)

since.description: who: from this local time, e.g. 2026-10-17

until.description: who: up to this local time

tools.description: Find likely duplicates, stale todos and records filed in the wrong project, and put them in the review queue as suggestions (write; project required; additive: nothing is moved, closed or deleted). The user approves or rejects each one; approving applies only that suggestion and it can be undone with history. Suggestions the user rejected are not repeated. kinds: any of duplicate, stale, misfiled (default all).

Pass the file's contents as text. Lines that look like secrets are skipped, not stored.

The next AI sees it first in start_here. When you continue from a note, action=pickup with handoff_id so it stops showing. action=list (read).
